tick_execution: genuine owning-region tick entry to exit, separately from scheduler delay
tick_delay: observed tick start minus its recorded scheduled start, floored at zero
frame_duration: consecutive real frame-entry timestamps, including frame pacing
aggregate: retain subject values and independent sample counts; no server-average MSPT substitution
absolute_floor_policy: maximum paired baseline-only variation, frozen before any candidate measurement
comparison: median paired run-level difference within allowed bound AND at least two of three pairs within bound
